notes.newlyExtracted: Migration floors for scopes still being extracted, not coverage targets. New and changed production code targets 100% (see .github/skills/radius-code-quality/SKILL.md); these thresholds only keep an in-flight extraction from landing below the documented 80% line / 80% function / 70% branch gate. Ratchet each scope up to its measured value once its extraction is complete: `browser` measures 100% statements, branches, functions, and lines today and ratchets to 100 when Phase 4 lands its remaining entries.
